plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the Harbor Wallet mobile fixture, focusing on the primary settings/privacy flow and adjacent screens, while validating all interactive states and mobile viewport constraints.
plan.summary: The exploration will navigate through the app's primary tab-based screens (Home, Send, Receive, Activity, Account) to validate core wallet flows. It will then dive deep into the Account screen to uncover and test the settings/privacy features. Finally, it will re-run critical checks on a mobile viewport to validate layout warnings and responsive behavior within the simulated device frame.
assumptions: The Account tab (◉ Account) contains or leads to the settings/privacy features mentioned in the user goal.
The app is a single-page application where tab buttons and action buttons toggle visibility of different data-screens rather than navigating to new HTML files.
The '3 🔔' button will trigger a notification panel or modal, which may contain privacy-related alerts.
The layout warnings for small tap targets (38x38px and 42x16px) will be more pronounced and impactful during the mobile viewport testing phase.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets: '3 🔔' (38x38px) and 'See all' (42x16px) failing mobile accessibility guidelines.
Settings/Privacy controls: Potential for unclear toggles, missing confirmation dialogs for destructive privacy actions, or obscured navigation paths.
Send/Receive flows: Risk of missing input validation, unclear error states, or dead-end modals in the simulated UI.
Viewport overflow: Content within the simulated phone chassis might overflow or clip incorrectly on actual mobile viewports (≤460px).

phases.title: Home & Quick Actions
phases.objective: Validate the Home screen layout, asset display, and quick action button behaviors.
key_checks: Verify '3 🔔' button interaction and any notification panel appearance.
Click 'See all' for Recent Activity and verify navigation/transitions.
Test quick action buttons: ↑ Send, ↓ Receive, ⇄ Swap, + Top up.
Check for dynamic updates in the status bar (time ticking).
exit_criteria: Quick actions verified to trigger screen transitions or modals.

phases.title: Core Transaction Screens
phases.objective: Explore the Send, Receive, and Activity screens for usability, form validation, and state changes.
key_checks: Navigate to Send screen, test input field, and verify available controls.
Navigate to Receive screen, check for address/QR code display and copy/share actions.
Navigate to Activity screen, verify transaction list and filtering/interaction capabilities.
Attempt invalid input in the Send form to check error handling.
exit_criteria: Send, Receive, and Activity screens fully inspected.
Input interactions and validation states tested.
All visible buttons on these screens clicked.

phases.title: Account & Privacy Deep Dive
phases.objective: Locate and thoroughly test the Settings and Privacy controls under the Account tab.
key_checks: Navigate to Account screen and identify entry points to Settings/Privacy.
Toggle privacy settings (e.g., data sharing, analytics) and verify state retention if possible.
Check for clear labels, descriptions, and confirmations on privacy-impacting actions.
Explore other Account sub-sections (e.g., profile, security, help).
exit_criteria: Settings/Privacy screens located and fully interacted with.
All toggles/inputs in privacy settings exercised.
Navigation back to main Account screen verified.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-test critical flows and layout warnings on a mobile viewport to ensure responsive compliance.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and verify the phone chassis renders edge-to-edge (≤460px).
Re-validate tapping the small '3 🔔' and 'See all' targets for usability.
Check Account/Settings/Privacy flow for layout overflow or clipping issues on small screens.
Verify tab bar accessibility and hit areas on mobile.
exit_criteria: Mobile viewport renders correctly without horizontal scroll.
Small tap targets explicitly tested and critiqued.
Primary settings/privacy flow completed successfully on mobile.

coverage_targets.pages: Cover all virtual screens (data-screens) within index.html triggered by the tab bar and actions.
coverage_targets.features: Interact with all 39 buttons, 1 link, and 1 input detected in the prescan, focusing on privacy toggles and transaction inputs.
coverage_targets.mobile: Validate all layout warnings and complete the primary settings/privacy flow on a mobile viewport.

notes: Since this is a single-page app with a simulated phone frame, pay close attention to whether interactions correctly update the DOM/data-screen attributes or if they are just visual placeholders.
Keep an eye out for any console or network errors triggered by button clicks, as the prescan showed none initially.
